source_sql:
SELECT member_id, points,
       SUM(points) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY seq_no) AS running_total
  FROM point_history
 WHERE member_id = 1

fetch.scalardb_sql: SELECT member_id, seq_no, points FROM point_history WHERE member_id = 1
